name: holehe
network: outbound HTTP(S) to public account-recovery endpoints
review_notes: Modular architecture: one Python module per service, httpx calls only.
Upstream activity is low: watch for broken modules and false negatives.
GPL-3.0: integrated through a separate subprocess with no code linkage, so the rest of the platform is not affected by the licence.
Obfuscated responses (recovery email/phone) are stored verbatim.
A 'rate limited' result is NOT 'no account': it is stored as inconclusive.
